verdict.rationale: Aircall's own marketing says calls, SMS, and messaging stay connected to your CRM (aircall-docs-25). It also says AI Assistants and AI Agents update CRM records and log outcomes automatically (aircall-docs-23, aircall-docs-21). These are thin first-party claims with no detail on which CRMs are supported or how activities are matched to the right contact; the webhook and API tutorials are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented native CRM integrations, automatic call and SMS activity logging specifics, contact-matching behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
